ideas.description: Base: the current tip, E070 code (e945ed5). It is 2@16 + 1.25@24 + 4@32 px at 7.25 ep and already contains the Fable tail, as the I083 drop note confirms. Precondition, untimed: log the source hash and a one-line diff against e945ed5, so this run joins the right family (H4.2.4). Change only the final-EMA window. Start the final EMA 20 steps before the end instead of 8. Keep the cadence (every 4 steps) and the lerp (ema = 0.7*ema + 0.3*net via foreach_lerp), so there are ~5 updates instead of ~2. Initialize the EMA from the net weights at the window start, using buffers allocated in build and reset in prepare. Leave the floor-hold point (~96% of steps), the lookahead stop point, eval on the EMA weights and the BN buffers copied from the net all unchanged. This is a host-side step-index change only, so nothing new compiles. Decide with an untimed off-seed run on seeds 3-10. In the same session, rerun the tip off-seed so the baseline (0.7530) gets a second sample. Add two scored runs. Instrumentation for H4.4.1/H4.5.1: log per-seed final-weight checksums and the cuDNN conv kernel names per (layer, shape).
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (4.57-4.61 s; a few extra foreach_lerp calls). E079 showed the 2-update final EMA is worth ~0.15-0.2 pp. A longer window that also averages iterates from before the floor-hold should add +0.05 to +0.15 pp: off-seed mean ~0.7535-0.7545 against a tip of ~0.7530, and a two-run scored pool of ~0.7540-0.7555 against 0.7537. If both instruments gain >=+0.1 pp, the result becomes the tip and funds the gated 32 px trim. A result within ±0.05 pp means the window length is saturated at 8 steps, so try the uniform-average arm next. If it is worse by >=0.1 pp, averaging over pre-floor iterates hurts at this LR.

ideas.description: Sibling arm of the EMA-window idea, sharing its off-seed tip baseline. Base: E070 code. Replace the final exponential EMA with a LAWA-style uniform average: take a snapshot of the net weights every 4 steps over the last 20 steps (5 snapshots), keep them as a running mean via foreach_lerp with weight 1/k for the k-th snapshot, and evaluate on the mean with the BN buffers copied from the net. The floor-hold and lookahead stop stay unchanged. Buffers are allocated in build and reset in prepare, and nothing recompiles. Change nothing else. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs, against the same tip off-seed baseline as the EMA-window idea.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.6%). Accuracy +0.0 to +0.15 pp versus the tip, i.e. off-seed ~0.7530-0.7545. If it beats both the tip and the EMA-window arm by >=0.07 pp off-seed, a uniform weighting is the better averaging design for this ~236-step regime. If it is no better than the EMA-window arm, the averaging axis is closed after the winner of the two is banked.

ideas.description: Step 1 is free: read the filter-renorm code in the tip (E070 code) and log whether the target norm is constant or already decays. If it already decays, retire H9.1.1 and do not run this. Otherwise, change only the renorm target so it decays linearly from the tip's current value c to 0.157c over training, matching hiverge's 0.5012->0.0786 ratio. Compute it from progress inside the compiled Muon update as a 0-d GPU tensor, so nothing recompiles, and apply it on the existing renorm cadence (every 2+int(15*progress) steps). LR, floor, tail and everything else stay unchanged. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.6%). This is a structural change to the effective-step schedule, so its effect may exceed the scalar knobs: off-seed and scored pool -0.2 to +0.3 pp. If the off-seed gain is >=+0.15 pp and the scored pool gains >=+0.1 pp, it becomes the tip with margin for a 32 px trim. If the off-seed delta is within ±0.1 pp, the implicit schedule is not binding and H9.1 is refuted. If accuracy drops >=0.2 pp, the late relative step under the tip's constant norm is already right for Muon+BN at ~236 steps.

ideas.description: Base: E070 code. Keep bs 1536 for the 16 and 24 px phases, and run the 32 px phase (4 epochs) at bs 1024. Index LR warmup/decay, the floor-hold, the final-EMA window, lookahead and the renorm cadence by samples seen. The final-EMA window and lookahead stop stay at the same sample count as in the tip. Scale the SGD groups (BN biases, whitening bias, head bias) per phase by the E010 kilostep rule, and leave Muon lr and momentum unchanged. Compile the bs-1024 32 px train shape as a static graph and warm it up in build on synthetic data. Change nothing else. Pre-register the time cost: about +66 steps at 32 px. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs.
ideas.expected: Time +1.5 to +3% (4.65-4.72 s). If bs 1536's accuracy cost (E038, ~0.13-0.3 pp) arose in the tail, accuracy rises +0.1 to +0.25 pp (off-seed ~0.754-0.755). That buys accuracy at >=0.055 pp per 1% of time and can fund a 32 px trim larger than its cost. If the gain is <=0.05 pp, the batch cost did not arise in the tail, and H2.11 is closed. This is an explore idea; it does not become the tip on its own because it is slower.

ideas.description: Math-neutral. Base: E070 code. In build, allocate an empty pinned host buffer (torch.empty(..., dtype=uint8, pin_memory=True)) and a GPU destination tensor of the training set's shape, with no real data. In prepare, copy the uint8 training array into the pinned buffer, upload it with non_blocking=True into the preallocated GPU tensor, and sync once before normalization. Change nothing else. Log per-trial prepare and train times. Score twice; decide on the per-trial prepare logs, not on the totals.
ideas.expected: Per-seed accuracy bit-identical or within noise. If the trial-1 window is pageable-staging overhead, trial-1 prepare falls from ~0.098 s to <=0.04 s, and trials 2-3 stay <=0.025 s (the extra host memcpy into pinned memory must not cost more than it saves). Mean time drops ~0.4-0.6% (~4.56 s). If trial-1 prepare stays >=0.08 s, the slow window is link- or driver-level (e.g. PCIe link power state), not pageable memory, and the line is closed. If trials 2-3 get slower by more than trial 1 saves, revert.

ideas.description: Gated. Run only after the EMA-window, uniform-average or renorm-decay idea yields a new tip whose off-seed mean is >=0.7540 and whose two-run scored pool is >=0.7547. On that tip, cut the 32 px phase by 0.125 epoch: 2@16 + 1.25@24 + 3.875@32 px (7.125 ep), with a step-indexed switch. Rescale LR warmup/decay, the floor-hold point, the final-averaging window, lookahead and the renorm cadence to the new total step count, the same way E070 did. All shapes are already warmed up in build. Change nothing else. Score twice, plus an off-seed run on seeds 3-10. If the gate tip has >=+0.2 pp of margin off-seed, cut 0.25 epoch (3.75@32) instead.
ideas.expected: Time about -2.3% (~-0.11 s, ~4.47 s) for the 0.125 cut, or ~-4.5% for the 0.25 cut. Accuracy -0.05 to -0.12 pp (-0.1 to -0.25 for the 0.25 cut), at the Muon full-res slope of ~0.54 pp/epoch. This is the first fractional 32 px trim on a Muon base, and it measures whether the tail is binding (H2.10.5). If the loss is <=0.05 pp per 1%, it is banked as the tip. If the loss is >=0.3 pp per 0.25 epoch, the 32 px phase is binding and cuts must come from elsewhere.
